response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM c) AS avg_wins_minus_mean_of_country_avgs FROM c

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row is one record pooled by the country of its race's circuit, so AVG over all rows weights countries' races by number of constructors; NULL values are ignored by AVG.
The simple mean of country averages is taken over all countries that have at least one standings record (countries with no standings rows are excluded).
